title: Running a freelance practice
summary: Keeps clients, quotes, deadlines and invoices in one place, tells you the week's deadlines and who has not paid, and drafts the reminder for you to send.

asks.question: What payment terms do you give clients, and in which currency?
asks.why: To tell when an invoice is late.

asks.question: How do you send invoices: an app, a template, or by hand?
asks.why: So I keep them in step with how you already work.

homework.find: Their public portfolio or profile: what they make and for whom.

senses.describe: Payment notices from your bank or payment app
senses.ask: If I watch your mailbox, I can mark invoices paid the moment the money arrives.

senses.describe: Client calls and reviews on your calendar
senses.ask: With your calendar connected I can get you ready before each client call.

rhythms.do: This week's deadlines, invoices past due, and quotes still waiting for an answer.
Anything due tomorrow that is not marked done.
Match the payment to an open invoice by amount and client, and mark it paid; say which.

signals.when: an invoice is past its due date and unpaid
signals.say: Name the client, the invoice and how late it is.

check.sql: SELECT client, number, amount, currency, due FROM invoices WHERE paid IS NULL AND due < date('now') ORDER BY due

signals.when: a project is due within two days and not done
signals.say: Name the project and the day.

check.sql: SELECT client, project, deadline FROM projects WHERE status != 'done' AND deadline <= date('now', '+2 day') ORDER BY deadline

prepare.when: an invoice is more than a week late
prepare.describe: A polite payment reminder to the client
